page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. It is provisioned with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance type contains no integrated GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 6 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of external block storage for operating system installation and persistent data. Additionally, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default.

With fully dedicated core allocation, the hardware avoids performance degradation caused by noisy-neighbor contention or burstable CPU credits. Its balanced resource profile supports enterprise web applications, containerized microservices, build nodes, and general backend processing workloads that do not demand local disk I/O.
